values.note: Book online (ResNexus) or by phone, 952-445-8800 or 1-800-653-CAMP. 2026 reservations opened January 2. A $25 non-refundable deposit by credit card; no-shows lose it and pay one night. Holidays and special events may carry a minimum stay and prepayment. Site numbers are not guaranteed. Stays up to four months, then 60 days away; no year-round sites.

note: RV park owned and run by the Shakopee Mdewakanton Sioux Community beside Mystic Lake Casino, Prior Lake; paved rows of sites around a small pond, with a pavilion, playground and dog park. --Claude
summary: Operator site: 2026 May-Sep $45 Sun-Thu / $55 Fri-Sat (+tax), weekly $270, monthly $1,125; open Mar 16-Nov 13; ResNexus or phone, $25 deposit; showers, laundry, store, dump, RV wash, fuel, casino shuttle; military discount confirmed. Passes the gate ($45; Minneapolis-St Paul gateway as well). Google 4.5 (453). Site count conflict: operator says 48 paved sites, stored 122. Pin OK; not waterfront (pond).
